archive_sec1_desc: LISA (Healthy and Beautiful Environment) was initiated in November 2025 by Public Relations students from Universitas Bina Sarana Informatika (UBSI) Ciledug and Ciputat campuses. The project serves as an AI-powered Cyber PR campaign to bridge the information gap regarding 3R waste management and local waste bank integration for youth.
archive_sec2_desc: Throughout its journey, this innovation was awarded Winner: Creative AI Creator (Session 6) at the PR Awards 2025.
archive_sec3_desc: Following the conclusion of the official competition and campaign previously hosted at lingkungansehatasri.my.id, the LISA ecosystem is now permanently archived as a live personal portfolio at lisa.itsdvvn.my.id. All AI chat features, curated 139+ waste management guides, and interactive waste bank maps remain active 24/7 for research, education, and public documentation.
behind_desc_context: LISA was born from the initiative of UBSI Communication Science students in the PR Awards 2025 competition. Driven by the lack of practical waste education and the difficulty of finding verified waste banks in South Tangerang, this platform bridges that gap through an interactive conversational AI.
roadmap_subtitle: The phased journey of environmental assistant LISA, from campus competition validation to economic calculator systems and spatial technology.
fase_1_desc: Field survey of 39 waste bank locations across South Tangerang with UBSI students, curation of 139+ 3R sorting guides, and winning Creative AI Creator Session 6.
fase_2_title: PWA Web App & Supabase Vector Engine
fase_2_desc: 24/7 bilingual access (ID/EN), semantic search with Supabase pgvector, nearest waste bank locator, and ultra-fast Astro v5 performance.
fase_3_desc: Economic savings estimate (cuan) for sorted waste (PET bottles, cardboard, used cooking oil, cans) and CO2 emission reduction conversion calculator per deposit.
fase_4_desc: Smart proximity routing within < 5 KM via PostGIS, multi-file AI Vision waste detection, and GPS-integrated community illegal dump reporting.
codev_desc: LISA was born from an open-research initiative. We invite developers, researchers, waste bank managers, and environmental communities to co-develop bot intelligence and real action features:
codev_point1: Field validation of actual purchase rates and weighing schedules of Waste Banks.
codev_point2: Research on AI Vision waste classification models & economic calculator formulas.
codev_point3: Interactive educational modules adoption for school and university curriculums.
codev_footer_note: Open to developers, researchers, waste bank teams, and communities.
